tasks.objective: Provide a generic, safe orchestration bootstrap CLI.
implementationNotes: Use Bash and standard utilities only.
Preserve existing target files unless --force is supplied.
acceptanceCriteria: The CLI initializes templates in a target directory.
The CLI reports the next workflow owner from STATUS.md.
Automated tests cover initialization and status behavior.

tasks.objective: Run bounded Claude Code and Codex handoffs from workflow state.
implementationNotes: Use installed CLI executables in non-interactive mode.
Keep a correction limit and preserve logs under .agent/runs/.
Do not use dangerous permission bypass options.
acceptanceCriteria: A start command records a requirement and begins the planning phase.
A cycle command dispatches the responsible CLI from STATUS.md.
The cycle stops on approval, failure, an invalid state, or its correction limit.
Tests use fake executables and do not invoke real AI agents.
